The '''2021 Salford City Council election''' to elect members of [[Salford City Council]] in England took place on 6 May 2021, on the same day as other [[2021 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]].<ref>[https://www.salford.gov.uk/your-council/elections-and-voting/elections/future-elections/ Future elections] Salford City Council</ref><ref>[https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/920186/Election_Timetable_in_England_2019.pdf Future election timetable in England] Gov.uk</ref>

==Boundary changes==

The [[Local Government Boundary Commission for England]] has reported on the Salford Council area and has redrawn the local authority boundaries to create a new ward boundary map<ref>[https://s3-eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/lgbce/Reviews/North%20West/Greater%20Manchester/Salford/Final%20Recs/Salford%20Reprt%20Web.pdf Greater Manchester - Final Recommendations Report for Salford] Local Government Boundary Commission for England</ref>
